readings.title: Building Experience
readings.text:
Amir is considering a new job. He has a degree in engineering and is fluent in two languages. He is ambitious, hardworking and skillful at explaining technical ideas in simple language. Before he applies, he reads the job description carefully and considers which examples will show his strengths.

Before applying, Amir did volunteer work with a local community group. Every Saturday, he helped repair computers and taught basic online skills. He had to arrive on time, listen to people’s problems and organize simple tasks with two other volunteers. This experience showed that he was responsible and able to work with different people. It also helped him practise multitasking and time management.

At an interview, Amir plans to describe his experience clearly. He will explain that he is a team player, a fast learner and able to meet a deadline. He knows he does not have to know everything on his first day, but he must be ready to learn. He also plans to ask whether the company offers flexible hours or remote work after training.
